procedure: Used the already-flashed firmware revision 1cfb514 on the attached ESP32-S3 DevKitC-1.
Ran the expanded NostrSeal/esp32 smoke command make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem101 idf-smoke-capabilities after adding dynamic request-id exchanges in revision 2f1ca8c.
Verified static fixture requests and dynamic request-id variants for get_capabilities, get_public_key, and sign_event.
expected_result: The device echoes static and dynamic request ids for get_capabilities/get_public_key and refuses static and dynamic sign_event requests with signing_disabled.
observed_result: The device returned six valid nseal1f response frames: three shared fixture responses and three dynamic request-id responses. Dynamic get_capabilities and get_public_key returned ok=true, and dynamic sign_event returned ok=false with error.code signing_disabled.
limitations: Protocol smoke only; no trusted display, GPIO, camera, storage, secure boot, flash encryption, debug-lock, or real signing acceptance was tested.
The firmware was not rebuilt in this report; it reused the already-flashed revision 1cfb514 from the dynamic serial request-id milestone.
get_public_key uses the deterministic development fixture key, not production key custody.
sign_event is expected to remain disabled until the display, physical approval, provisioning, storage, and signed-output verification gates are complete.
